name: experiment-reporting-suite
description: Evidence-aligned experiment reporting with reproducible PDF delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Audit experiments and deliver rigorous reports.
interface.longDescription: Audits implementation, run settings, metrics, and figures; maps algorithms to experiments; and produces reproducible Markdown, HTML, and page-checked PDF reports.
defaultPrompt: Turn these experiment artifacts into a rigorous report.
Audit this report against the code and run configs.
Render this experiment report as a checked PDF.
